prompt: Oxymercuration of 3-methyl-1-butene with Hg(OAc)2 / H2O; then NaBH4. Draw the Markovnikov alcohol (no rearrangement).

traps.note: Mercurinium ion prevents the 1,2-hydride shift to a 3° cation that would otherwise happen under H+/H2O.

explanation: H2SO4/H2O here would give a 2° cation that rearranges via H-shift to the more stable 3° cation → tert-amyl alcohol. The mercurinium bridge in oxymercuration prevents that shift, so the Markovnikov alcohol forms cleanly without rearrangement.
